title: I'm SpongeBob!
blurb: Delivered with the unearned confidence of a creature who has never once read a room. SpongeBob introduces himself constantly across the series, always at maximum volume, always to people who did not ask — and the sheer undented enthusiasm is the entire joke. It makes a perfect entrance sound: play it on arriving anywhere, on volunteering for something you are unqualified to do, or on claiming an identity nobody had questioned in the first place. Twenty-five years in, the character's energy has still not depleted by a single percent. Who lives in a pineapple, indeed.
origin: SpongeBob's enthusiastic self-introduction from the series.
